subject: Request: 30-day trial bridge for Skyware integration
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyware.io>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skyware.io>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 30-day trial bridge for Skyware integration

Hi David,

Quick context: we started the Redwood sandbox last week and the team ran into a certificate rotation issue in our internal staging that blocked the connector. Our engineering lead estimates a two-three week fix (needs a vendor kernel bump and a retest across three adapters).

Because the integration delay pushes our demo and pilot timeline out by ~3 weeks, we wanted to ask whether Redwood can provide a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up (~5k tokens) so our PM can finish the end-to-end demo with Security present. This is a hard dependency for our Q3 procurement conversation.

We appreciate the partnership — we like the runtime characteristics so far and want to keep momentum. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Director of Engineering, Integrations
Skyware

Attachment: error_log-stacktrace.txt (text/plain)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyware.io>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 30-day trial bridge for Skyware integration

Marissa / Priyom — looping you in. Skyware hit a staging cert rotation bug; they say it will take ~2–3 weeks to remediate and that delays the demo with their Security team. They’re asking for a 30-day extension + a small sandbox top-up (5k tokens) to complete the end-to-end demo.

Key facts:
- Account: Skyware (mid-market; pilot in progress; procurement kickoff targeted end of June)
- Current trial window: ends 2027-05-20
- Business impact: demo + Security sign-off delays procurement; high likelihood of conversion if demo completes

Marissa — can you advise on approval path for a 30-day bridge + credit? If we need a credit policy exception, I can sign off for a one-time pilot allowance but wanted your guidance on FH (finance/discount) steps.

Priyom — please add any technical notes we should surface to support the ask. Alex: thanks for flagging — we’ll get back to you today with next steps.

-David

David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyware.io>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 30-day trial bridge for Skyware integration

Thanks David — and hi Alex, thanks for the clear summary. I reviewed Skyware’s usage and pipeline (low-risk sandbox activity). I’m comfortable advancing a 30-day trial bridge and a 5k token sandbox credit contingent on a signed short approval form (covers scope and T&Cs) and a mutual action plan note that captures the demo date.

Next steps I’ll take this morning:
- Draft/attach a short trial-extension approval PDF for sign-off (attaching 'trial-extension-approval-form.pdf').
- Add a one-page mutual action plan to the Drive and attach it ('mutual-action-plan.docx').
- Route to Finance for an exception flag (low touch) — I’ll request fast-track approval and note deal id SW-2027-0427.

Alex — when you get a sec, please: 1) confirm the new target demo date (week of May 31 preferred), and 2) initial the attached approval form and upload to the Drive link I’ll send. I’ll let you know as soon as Finance signs off — should be within 24 business hours.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: trial-extension-approval-form.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyware.io>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 30-day trial bridge for Skyware integration

Hi Alex — quick update and approval:

Finance has fast-tracked the request. We’ll authorize a 30-calendar-day trial extension from your current end date and apply a one-time 5,000 token sandbox credit. This is granted as a pilot allowance tied to the mutual action plan and the signed approval form.

I’ve authorized the change internally; Marissa will send the signed form and Drive link. Alex, please sign the attached approval PDF and confirm the demo week (week of May 31) so we can lock scheduling and spin up the security review.

If the team needs a short sync (15 min) to unblock anything technical, David and I are available tomorrow morning.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Note: Applied credit = 5,000 sandbox tokens; extension window = +30 days.
